governance.voting_structure: Single class of shares; each ordinary share entitles the holder to one vote (one share, one vote). Cumulative voting is not permitted.

citations.quote: The Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee of our Board of Directors (the “Board”) has nominated eleven individuals to be re-elected at the meeting.

The Board has determined that all Director nominees other than the CEO are “independent” as that term is defined in the applicable listing standards of the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE listing standards”).
As of the record date, there were 2,308,359,941 shares of Amcor outstanding. Each ordinary share entitles the shareholder of record to one vote. Cumulative voting is not permitted.
Single class of shares ... All share capital is composed of voting shares; Amcor does not have any non-voting shares
